verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents user-defined ingestion workflows, which can be built and edited with natural-language prompts in the AI Editor, and incoming webhooks that receive external events and trigger those workflows. That is a real, product-native event-to-action mechanism, but it is scoped to data ingestion rather than a general rule engine. Missing for 10: general-purpose event-condition-action rules beyond ingestion, documentation of the available rule conditions and action types (e.g., auto-creating tickets or tasks on events), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
Trigger ingestion workflows, Process external events
Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
